subject.title: Carlsbad Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 1

text: I’m a proud parent of four children who have attended Carlsbad Unified schools since 2004. As a fourth-generation Carlsbad resident, I have deep roots in our community and a personal understanding of the schools that serve our families.

My professional experience as a local and international Realtor has strengthened my leadership, communication, and financial skills. I have also served as President of the Carlsbad chapter of Business Network International in 2023 and again in 2026.

Service has always been at the heart of my commitment to Carlsbad. I have volunteered as President of the Valley Middle School Site Council, a Parent Security Volunteer, PTA volunteer, Team Parent for Carlsbad Boardriders surf events, and with Homefront Fighters, supporting military families.

As a minority, and a first-generation graduate of the University of California, San Diego with degrees in Psychology and Sociology, I value the opportunities education creates. My education in sports medicine, business, and personal training reinforces my commitment to student health and well-being.

I’m running to bring action, accountability, and common-sense leadership to our schools by strengthening parent engagement, supporting academic excellence, improving student behavior, increasing e-bike safety, expanding recess, and reducing unnecessary screen time. It would be an honor to serve my hometown! Vote Amber for Carlsbad Schools!

text: As a longtime Carlsbad homeowner, parent, and educator, I bring nearly three decades of experience in elementary and secondary education to the school board. As a mentor, teacher, assistant principal, principal, and now as a Board Trustee, I believe public education gives students the opportunity to become strong, independent members of our community.

I believe in evidence-based instruction and sound research rather than trends, ensuring students receive the education they need for their future. That belief guides how I make decisions as a board member; researched, knowledgeable, and with stakeholder input.

Every student deserves equitable access to safe, supportive learning environments and the social-emotional support they need to thrive, including fair and consistent practices that proactively contribute to strong school communities with positive school cultures.

I bring a strong understanding of our LCAP and policy and how it translates into practice, ensuring Board decisions serve our schools well. This includes knowledge of state and federal funding, including LCFF, and Basic Aid, and how they shape the District budget.
My experience reflects not only my work on the Carlsbad Unified School District Board of Trustees, but as an advocate for public education.
Thank you for entrusting me to continue my work with the Carlsbad Unified School District.
